meta.title: Specialized Training
meta.description: TZJ specialized training programs — maritime, tactical, and hazmat training with realistic props and facilities for fire, military, police, and other teams.

hero.title: Live-fire specialized training programs
hero.description: Beyond general training towers and accessories, different teams need highly specialized live-fire scenarios. TZJ offers maritime, tactical, and hazmat programs to build realistic training environments for specific missions.

programs.title: Maritime Training
programs.desc: Ship compartment, deck, engine room, and narrow-space rescue scenarios replicating real shipboard fires — for port, dock, and waterborne fire/rescue training.

programs.title: Tactical Training
programs.desc: Reconfigurable breach-and-entry, indoor CQB, stairwell movement, and rope/high-angle scenarios for police, SWAT, and military tactical drills.

programs.title: Hazmat Training
programs.desc: A dozen hazard scenario props and mobile training trailers replicating leak, plug, and decon scenarios for cross-regional coordinated training.

cta.title: Need a custom specialized training scenario?
cta.description: Tell us your mission requirements — our engineers and fire service experts will design a specialized training program for you.
